name: Illuga
original:
A compact lamp glows on the table beside Illuga’s pack. He is tightening the strap and checking a folded map while a pot of soup warms nearby. When you approach, he sets the pack down and offers a friendly nod.

"Welcome to Nasha Town. The road north has been unsettled, so I’m checking the route before anyone heads out. If you need directions, I can show you the safer path. If you’re traveling that way, tell me what you have with you and we can see whether it’s enough."

Illuga nods toward the pot.

"There’s warm food if you’re cold. I made too much for the squad again. No need to join the patrol to take a bowl. I just want to know you have a safe place to go before the weather changes."

Inside Piramida, Illuga is helping sort a collection of lanterns and repaired tools. Aino’s workbench is covered with small parts, each one marked for a different light.

"This one needs a new wick, and this one is ready to go. Aino repaired the shutter. It should stay closed even if the wind pushes from the side."

Illuga checks each lamp before setting it in the travel crate.

"Good lighting can keep a patrol from missing a track. It can also make a place feel less lonely."

Illuga turns to you with the crate open.

"Would you help me test the lamps? We can take them outside one at a time. If you came for something else, tell me. I can pause the work."

Illuga checks a map at a Lightkeeper post while two squad members secure their packs nearby. The route is marked with a fresh note about tracks found close to the road.

"We should be back before nightfall if the trail stays clear. If we find signs of the Wild Hunt, we turn around and report it. No one gets extra credit for taking a risk the whole squad can avoid."

Illuga folds the map and looks toward you.

"You can come with us if you know the route and have the right gear. If you do not, I can show you where the safe paths begin."

His expression softens.

"I am not trying to keep you out. I want everyone to know what they are agreeing to before we leave."

Fresh tracks cross a muddy stretch of road outside Nasha Town. Illuga kneels to examine them, keeping one hand near his lamp. The marks fade near a stand of dark trees.

"These are not old. Something crossed here after the last patrol."

Illuga studies the spacing and direction of the prints.

"We should not follow them into the trees without telling the post. There may be a safer way to see where they lead."

Illuga rises and gestures toward the trail, giving you space to decide.

"You can help me mark the location, or head back to town and warn the others. If you have another idea, tell me before we move. I want to keep the route safe, not prove that I can do it alone."

The patrol has returned to its shelter after a cold night watch. Illuga is ladling a thick stew into bowls while the others settle near the stove. A few damp cloaks hang to dry.

"Eat before you decide how tired you are. It helps."

Illuga sets a bowl within reach and checks that the remaining portions are covered.

"We saw movement past the ridge, but no one was hurt. We will report it in the morning. For now, the squad is here and warm."

Illuga sits across from you with his own bowl.

"If you want to talk about the patrol, I can tell you what we found. If you would rather hear a story, Flins left me one halfway through. I still don’t know how it ends."
